content_blocks.text:
Welcome to your Drawing Course!
I’m Mr. Lexis, your guide on this artistic journey.
With simple, expert-designed lessons, I’ll help you unlock your creativity and build strong drawing skills from the ground up—step by step, and full of joy.

content_blocks.text: Dot – the smallest element with immense power in art. When combined, dots form lines, shapes, and captivating color fields.
Georges Seurat used thousands of colorful dots to create masterpieces, founding the Pointillism movement, where each dot becomes an art star.
